name: Joseph
description: Mary's husband living at the time of the New Testament

points: Joseph was the heir to the throne, but under Rome, with Herod the Edomite placed on it, and it does not come back until Christ returns and conquers Edom.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel; and on down to Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ. That is the Branch line, right through Zerubbabel. Everybody see that.
Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

That part right there, Christianity says before they came together means sex — before they had sex. No. When you read from Genesis, that is why I gave you all those scriptures about the marriage feast and then the consummation in the marriage chamber. Before they came together was before the wedding feast. That is what it is talking about. So she and Joseph had already dealt together sexually.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Before they came together means before the customary wedding feast; as Laban made a feast and brought Leah to Jacob, coming together is the wedding, and Joseph and Mary lay together before it.

Espousal is marriage, which is why a betrothed woman who lies with another commits adultery; Mary was Joseph's wife by espousal, so there was no fornication, and the angel says take unto thee Mary thy wife.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Joseph, a just man, was minded to put her away privily: to hide her, as Elisabeth hid herself five months, because a pregnant girl returned to her father's house would be made a public example and put to death, as Tamar nearly was.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The angel called him Joseph, thou son of David: the line is Joseph's, and that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost means of the prophecy, the seed promised to David out of his bowels and of the fruit of his loins according to the flesh.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: and when they were departed behold the angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream saying arise and take the young child and his mother and flee into Egypt flee where flee into Egypt flee into Africa read and be thou there until I bring thee word for Herod will seek the young child to destroy now the reason the angel told him to hide in Africa was why.

note.label: The Truth Behind Christmas and New Years

points: The angel tells Joseph to take the young child and his mother and flee into Egypt, because Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

note.label: Matthew 2: The Wise Men, Herod's Fear, and the Flight into Egypt

points: Caesar's taxing sent everyone to his own city; Joseph went up from Nazareth, where Mary had returned and where they were together, to Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Joseph went up from Nazareth to Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David, to be taxed with Mary his espoused wife. To be taxed with Mary means they filed jointly. So I do not know where brothers and sisters get this idea that we are sovereign and do not have to pay taxes; you are going to get yourself jacked up, and anybody who listens to you.
A decree from Caesar Augustus sends every man to his own city to be taxed, and Joseph goes up to Bethlehem because he was of the house and lineage of David.

note.label: Luke 2: The Birth at Bethlehem and the Child in the Temple

points: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli. So when Christ started teaching he was thirty years of age. It was not by accident — that was the age when the priesthood started.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Jesus, being as was supposed the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli; everyone knew whose son he was.

Joseph is written as Heli's son because Heli had no sons and Joseph inherited his land as his son-in-law, exactly as Tobias stood in Raguel's record; his biological father is Jacob in Matthew 1, and both houses are Judah, which is why he could inherit both lands.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Jesus began to be about thirty years of age, being, as was supposed, the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli. Heli was the father of Mary, so this line is reckoned through the son-in-law.

note.label: Luke 3: The Preaching of John and the Generations Back to Adam

points: After all those gracious words, the first thing out of their mouths was, Is not this Joseph's son?

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: They wonder at the gracious words, and then ask, Is not this Joseph's son? No prophet is accepted in his own country.

cases.name: Joseph, the husband of Mary
cases.charge: A just man; doing as the angel of the Lord bade him, four times, without a word recorded
cases.preview: Joseph stands in the record as the husband of Mary and the last name in the king’s line that runs through Zerubbabel, the heir to a throne he could not sit on because the nation was in captivity.
